research_findings: The codebase lacked a global, in-memory rate limiting mechanism for API routes to protect them against brute forcing or repetitive abusive requests, especially the heavy /api/ai endpoints.
Discovered that an in-memory Map could be used with a token bucket algorithm to provide an efficient and lightweight rate limiter.
Identified the need to prevent memory leaks by adding a cleanup interval for the Map that uses .unref() to not block the Node process from exiting.
features_improved: Protected '/api/ai/chat' with a 10 req/minute rate limit.
Protected '/api/ai/help' with a 10 req/minute rate limit.
Protected '/api/ai/evaluate' with a 10 req/minute rate limit.
new_features_added: Added a generic RateLimiter utility class implementing a Token Bucket algorithm with automatic background cleanup of stale entries.
next_steps_for_next_run: Consider expanding the RateLimiter to use Redis if running in a distributed environment (serverless scaling across regions).
Extend rate limiting to auth routes if brute-force login attempts are a concern.
